verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents its own escalation behaviour. It can scope deployment to trained topics and leave the rest to the human team, response guardrails can escalate, and specialist or regulatory cases escalate with full interaction history to a human in the same platform. Configurable handoff triggers are only evidenced for topic scope and guardrail or policy conditions, and reliability rests on vendor claims about guardrail testing. Missing for 10: configurable sentiment-based triggers, customer-tier-based triggers, explicit human-request handling, detailed docs on configuring handoff rules, and independent evidence that handoff rules are reliably obeyed.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, I configure when the agent must hand off — by topic, sentiment, customer tier, or explicit request — and it reliably obeys
